title: Claude partial native route: GCP preservation preflight
scope: Read-only source and prior-evidence review. No device, private account data, reminder state, active track, service, or app state was read or changed.

finding.explanation: Track selection persists the new active track before reconciling the single active-track-bound reminder source. Track-scoped GCP goals and accepted plans are not rewritten by a Claude practice session, but reminder identity and native schedules can be rebound or cleared while Claude is active. Returning to GCP can reconcile its still-valid plan and recreate its slots; native notification IDs are not guaranteed to remain stable.
finding.ordinaryPartialExposure: The versioned in-memory source probe completed an ordinary 40-question Claude Focus Practice session, then prepared ordinary 10-, 20-, and 40-question follow-ons. All six multiple-choice transfer questions appeared in each follow-on for that exact empty-history probe input. This establishes source/runtime feasibility only; device history may select differently.

unknownsRootMustReadBeforeAnySwitch: Current active track and whether an active session or draft exists.
GCP goal status/revision and accepted-plan status, identity/revisions, goal revision, content pin, timezone, and slots.
Claude goal/plan validity and reminder-source branch.
Reminder enabled/pending state, active identity track, slots, journal/schema, notification permission, and app-owned scheduled reminders.
Guest versus bound account status, without initiating sync or account lifecycle transitions.

sourceEffects.effect: The selector writes the new active track first, then marks account data pending through the existing learning-read-model path. The selector does not itself call account sync.
sourceEffects.handling: Capture the original track privately; avoid sign-in, sign-out, adoption, account sync, or profile changes.

sourceEffects.effect: Track-specific storage keys and revision-checked atomic plan writes keep GCP goal/plan records separate. A Claude track switch or Claude practice does not write those GCP records.
sourceEffects.handling: Compare GCP goal/plan semantic identity and slots through existing read-only projections before and after; do not edit them.

sourceEffects.effect: The intended durable additions are Claude session/results/attempts and the account pending marker. GCP attempt selection is scoped to its track/content pool.
sourceEffects.handling: Confirm GCP result/progress remains unchanged and report the new Claude records as intended changes.

sourceEffects.effect: Reconciliation follows the active track. An invalid Claude source can cancel recorded app reminder IDs and clear reminder identity/slots; a valid enabled Claude source can schedule Claude-bound reminders and cancel obsolete GCP IDs. Failure can leave pending journal state. Returning to GCP can reconcile its valid plan and slots, but not promise the same OS IDs.
sourceEffects.handling: Compare settings, identity, slots, permission, journal, and app-owned schedules. Stop before the switch if the expected preservation includes continuous GCP reminder delivery or if current source state makes the branch unacceptable.

safeInspectionCandidates: In the already-running app JS process: existing track/goal/plan readers and HomePlanSnapshotReader for stable projections.
In that same process: readCanonicalEnvelope for only named keys with pure notification-settings and journal guards, without legacy migration.
The already-initialized Expo notification adapter getPermission() and listScheduledReminders(transactionId) for platform reads.
doNotTreatAsPureRead: getDeviceReminderSettingsSnapshot() and getDeviceReminderJournal() can migrate legacy records while reading.
Notification Settings refresh calls reminder reconciliation and may schedule or cancel reminders.
existingReadPathsAndCautions.privateData: Do not place live IDs, account contents, raw envelopes, or credentials in the report. The root/device owner retains any current-state receipt privately.

liveReadCapability.rootConfirmedInspectorProbe: A read-only inspector probe against the running development app exposed the current-session Metro __r/getModules loader and these already-initialized modules: canonicalRecordCodec (1294), mmkvClient (1295), notificationSettingsRepository (1354), expoNotificationPlatform (1404). No stored record payload was read or changed by that capability probe.
liveReadCapability.stability: Development-only, in-process inspection; module IDs are bundle-specific and are not a stable product or host API.
liveReadCapability.smallestSafeFollowup: In the same active inspector session only, use existing exported getters/readCanonicalEnvelope on the exact active-track, GCP/Claude goal and plan, session, notification-settings, and notification-journal keys; project required fields privately. Use the existing pure notification guards and Expo getPermission/listScheduledReminders(transactionId). Do not bootstrap storage, call migration-capable reminder snapshots, enumerate all keys, dump raw records, or store live IDs in this packet.
liveReadCapability.notAvailable: No stable host-callable snapshot/export bridge, MMKV filesystem parser, or key export was found. Storage is AES-256 MMKV opened with a random in-app key kept through iOS Keychain-backed SecureStore. Existing development deep links are reset-learning-state and advance-clock commands, not inspection commands.
liveReadCapability.fallback: If the current Hermes session or initialized modules are unavailable, do not extract database/keychain data or add inspection tooling here; identify unreadable baseline fields and stop before the track switch.

conditionalSequence: Root reads and privately records the listed baseline using existing read paths; no action proceeds if the active session, reminder journal, current GCP/Claude source, or required preservation cannot be safely reconciled.
Use the normal track selector to choose Claude. Since the track write precedes reminder reconciliation, stop on pending/error status; do not assume rollback.

Use the ordinary Practice Hub/Focus Practice route for a 40-question session, complete normally, then prepare the next ordinary session. Do not seed history, replace questions, or reorder the session.

Continue only if the actually prepared question is one of the six multiple-choice transfer items. Submit one authored accepted option and observe the normal partial result; bind evidence to the actual presented question and result.

Return to GCP with the normal selector and compare the goal/plan semantics, reminder settings/journal, permission and scheduled app-owned reminders against the private baseline. Same reminder slots are sufficient for schedule comparison; identical native IDs are not guaranteed.
limits: The source-memory probe is not native evidence and does not predict the device's current selection history.
No track switch, device action, live-state inspection, external reminder-delivery proof, Premium use, backend call, or native acceptance occurred in this preflight.

If continuous GCP reminder delivery is required throughout the Claude excursion, the current active-track-bound reminder contract cannot guarantee it; resolve scope before any switch rather than changing reminder ownership.

sourceMemoryProbe.result: Six multiple-choice transfer questions appeared in the actual prepared follow-on 10/20/40 sessions for the exact empty-history in-memory input; one accepted option produced partial 4/5.

priorNativeEvidence.limit: GCP-only prior session; no track switch or current device-state guarantee.
